story: Stage 6 of La Vuelta featured a 10-man breakaway that shaped the race. On the penultimate climb, the Alto de la Comella, Jay Vine launched a decisive attack, dropping his companions. He maintained his lead over the final kilometers and powered to the finish, celebrating a commanding solo victory. Torstein Træen took over the red jersey.
